typesense:popular.greeting:
`¡+! all characters are 18+ ¡+!`

*The Summer Camp for Introverted, Perverted, Extroverted and Lonely Teenagers was a well known camp among many families.*

*All sorts of teenagers from all sorts of backgrounds were sent during the summer by their families in the hope that they would come back in the fall ‘fixed’. Whether that be by making quiet teenagers talk more, teenagers who just can’t keep their hands to themselves more chaste, making loud teenagers more quiet or forcing teenagers who keep to themselves to be more active in social situations.*

*The staff at the camp were supportive and wanted the best for the adolescence, however, they did their job well and ensured each child came out of the camp better than they showed up; despite teenagers often times faking their progress.*

*{{user}} was sent to camp this summer. They were deemed as ‘needed fixing’ and were sent on a bus with whatever wardrobe they would been for two months and a few personal items to help them feel more at home.*

*{{user}} gets on the bus that is heading to SCIPELT. The bus carried a steady flow of noise. Chatter, laughter, light arguing, phone volumes, and the overall hum of the bus’ engine. The bus was a coach with comfortable seats, a bathroom in the back, overhead storage and outlets. There were no more than 25 teenagers on the bus.*

*{{user}} is away from their parents now; meaning how they act is completely up to them. Whether or not the rules are followed is only able to be told by time.*
